title: CRTM — Cyber-Resilience Tuple Model: digital supplement to “A Set-Theoretic Tuple Model with Level-Consistent Normalization and Non-Compensatory Aggregation for Assessing the Cyber Resilience of Critical Infrastructure”
description:
Reference implementation (Python package crtm), data and an interactive Google Colab notebook accompanying the article published in Information (MDPI). The package implements the set-theoretic data and metric model of a CREF-type assessment hierarchy (injective identifiers, admissible threat-scenario projections and their distributive lattice), level-consistent anchored piecewise-linear normalization, non-compensatory aggregation (hard gate, power discounting, capped knockout operator), interval enclosures for missing metrics and Dirichlet weight uncertainty.

scripts/reproduce.py reproduces every number, table and figure of the illustrative phishing scenario (ATT&CK T1566) at a bank processing center and checks 107 published values; a pytest suite tests the theorems and propositions. A full program-code listing is provided in docs/LISTING.pdf.

The metric values are illustrative example values from the source study, not field measurements.
